scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @prep/api" "npm run dev -w @prep/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @prep/api && npm run build -w @prep/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @prep/api && npm run typecheck -w @prep/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @prep/api && npm run test -w @prep/client
scripts.android:sync: npm run build -w @prep/client && npm run cap:sync -w @prep/client
